title: Whisper Speech-to-Text AI Reportedly Found to Create Violent Hallucinations

behaviors.text: Researchers at Cornell reportedly found that OpenAI's Whisper, a speech-to-text system, can hallucinate violent language and fabricated details, especially with long pauses in speech, such as from those with speech [person].
Analyzing 13,000 clips, they determined 1% contained harmful hallucinations.
These errors pose risks in hiring, legal trials, and medical documentation.
The study suggests improving model training to reduce these hallucinations for diverse speaking patterns.
